mcqs.question: Under Andhra Pradesh’s AP Cyber Guard system, within what time should complaints received through the 1930 helpline be responded to?
options: By the end of the year
mcqs.explanation: AP Cyber Guard requires complaints received through the 1930 helpline to be responded to within the first 30 minutes, along with temporary lien marking on accounts. The 24×7 period refers to the Cyber War Room, not the complaint-response deadline.

mcqs.question: How many shortlisted entries included Andhra Pradesh’s Andhra Pradesh Community-Managed Natural Farming (APCNF) for the Food Planet Prize 2026?
mcqs.explanation: APCNF was among 35 shortlisted entries for the Food Planet Prize 2026 from more than 1,000 nominations across 19 countries, representing India. The figures 19 and 1,000-plus refer to the number of countries and nominations, while approximately ₹14 crore is the winner’s prize.
